meta.description: Import CFDI, payment complements, SAT electronic accounting and bank statements (beta), and turn them into management reports and findings.

hero.title: The intelligence layer behind your business.
hero.subtitle: Your invoices and your books already record what happened. Forcelis imports them, structures the information and turns it into actionable intelligence.

architecture.title: How it fits together
architecture.intro: Nothing is replaced. You import files you already download, and the platform works on top of them.
architecture.diagramAlt: Diagram: four sources of information — CFDI, payment complements, SAT electronic accounting and banking, the last one in beta — feed Forcelis, which imports, normalizes, analyzes and explains the data, and produces business decisions.

principles.title: Four decisions that shape the product
principles.intro: Engineering constraints, not marketing claims. Each one closes off a shortcut that would have been easier to take.

items.label: Deterministic
items.title: Numbers are calculated by the analytical engine.
items.body: Every figure comes from a deterministic analytical engine with tests that pin known answers — four customers at 25% each gives an HHI of exactly 0.25. No number in the product is produced by a language model, because a number you cannot reproduce is a number you cannot defend in a management meeting.

items.label: Private
items.title: Each company's information remains isolated.
items.body: Isolation is enforced at four independent layers: an automatic tenant filter in the data layer, ownership stamped on every write, authorization checked before any scope opens, and row-level security inside PostgreSQL itself. The last one matters because the first three live in application code, and application code can be bypassed.

items.label: Secure
items.title: No tax portal or banking credentials required.
items.body: There is no field for an e.firma or a tax portal password anywhere in the product, and there never will be. Ingestion is by files the client downloads themselves from their own systems. A credential you never hold is a credential you cannot lose.

items.label: Honest
items.title: Missing information is reported, not invented.
items.body: When the information needed for a metric is not there, the platform says so and explains why, instead of returning a zero or a plausible-looking estimate. A silent zero is indistinguishable from a real result, and that is how bad decisions get made confidently.

status.title: What runs today
status.intro: Everything in this section is built and running. What is coming is below, marked as roadmap.

steps.title: Import data
steps.body: Files you already download: CFDI, payment complements, SAT electronic accounting and, in beta, bank statements.

steps.title: Standardize
steps.body: Concepts and products grouped into one stable managerial catalogue.

steps.title: Analyze
steps.body: Five tested engines: margin, concentration, cost inflation, collection, forecast.

steps.title: Identify findings
steps.body: What moved, why, and what it is worth — stated with the action it implies.

steps.title: Deliver results
steps.body: Report, interactive dashboard and Excel: the formats a finance team already uses.

today.title: Multi-company under the advisor's brand
today.body: An accountant, practice or consultant administers dozens of companies from a single account and delivers reports under their own brand.

today.title: CFDI ingestion
today.body: Issued and received invoices, payment complements, payroll and withholding documents, uploaded as files. Handles the mess that comes with real data: duplicates, malformed XML, unnormalizable units.

today.title: Normalization and managerial curation
today.body: Concepts and products grouped into a stable managerial catalogue, so the same item is the same item across suppliers and periods.

today.title: Five analytical engines
today.body: Price dispersion, customer concentration and churn, input cost inflation, business pulse, and forecast — each tested against scenarios with known answers.

today.title: Real cash collection
today.body: Collection measured from payment complements rather than assumed from invoice dates, with receivable and payable aging and a stated coverage percentage.

today.title: Managerial income statement
today.body: Restated results with history, comparable period over period, reconciled against the underlying documents.

today.title: Interactive dashboards
today.body: Charts, filters and drill-down, rendered by a purpose-built engine so the product works on a slow connection.

today.title: Accounts, login and MFA
today.body: Working user accounts with time-based two-factor authentication, encrypted secrets and single-use recovery codes.

today.title: Deliverables
today.body: Word report, self-contained HTML dashboard and Excel export — the formats a finance team already circulates.

future.title: Sector comparison
future.body: Compare against your sector using public INEGI data, instead of only against your own history.

future.title: Anonymous benchmark
future.body: A benchmark built from CFDI, released only in groups of at least 3 companies and only with each company's signed authorization.

status.roadmapIntro: Built or in progress, but not offered yet. It is here so you know where the product is going, not so you can count on it today.

boundaries.title: What the platform is not
items: It is not an ERP, and it does not run your operation.
It does not replace your accounting system or your accountant.
It does not issue tax opinions or determine tax positions.
It does not require access to your tax portal or your bank.

closing.title: See it against your own numbers.
closing.body: See the plans and their prices, or ask for a product demo. How long it takes depends on the type of client.
